responsibility: Implements RTL-specific diagnostics, primarily for inline asm represented in RTL. It locates the source position associated with ASM_OPERANDS inside an rtl insn, routes warnings and errors through GCC’s diagnostic framework with that location, and provides fatal-insn helpers that print the offending rtl and abort when an insn is unrecognizable or fails its constraints, forming the backend-facing error path for malformed RTL or asm operands.
same_name_distinction: Implements the RTL diagnostic behavior declared in gcc/rtl-error.h by finding source locations for ASM_OPERANDS, issuing asm-specific diagnostics, and providing fatal-insn reporting helpers; the header is only the small declaration surface for those entry points.
